description: Machine-readable data classification (ADR-002). Every path has exactly one class. 'public' is the complement of the other two: any tracked file not matching below is public by definition, and the coverage test enforces the two explicit classes.

encrypted_in_repo.description: Committed only as SOPS ciphertext. Must match a .sops.yaml creation rule.

never_in_git.description: Exists only on this machine. Must be gitignored and absent from the index.

plaintext_forbidden_under.description: Directories where any tracked file MUST be ciphertext (no plaintext exceptions, not even docs).
